title: No raw BG values in nightscout for G6
body:
I recently switched from G5 to G6. 
I used the G5 with the same setup than now and raw BG dots were shown in NS. Now with G6 the raw values are no longer shown. All I changed was to activate the G6 support in XDrip. 
I use the latest XDrip nightly (23OCT) and tried master 0.10.3 and dev 0.11.0 (22OCT) in NS. 

Are raw values no longer available for G6?
